links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of AI models versus human evaluators on lower limb edema images
links.effect: EfficientNetV2 achieved the highest accuracy of 78.6%; human evaluators' diagnostic accuracy plateaued at 62.7%.
links.quote: The AI system consistently outperformed human evaluators, whose diagnostic accuracy plateaued at 62.7%.

unlisted_practices: Grad-CAM saliency maps to interpret imaging model predictions

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates deep learning models on clinical photos of lower limb edema and compares model accuracy to human evaluators in a reader study, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
